major_concerns: Emulation (Mininet/container) may not capture vendor-specific semantics leading to mismatch with verifier/emulation ground truth.
Verifier coverage (Batfish/NetKAT) may not model all device dialects -> systematic false negatives.
Sample size (60) and task diversity may be insufficient for strong external validity.
Hosted-API nondeterminism and rate limits could bias paired comparisons if not strictly controlled.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact verifier(s), versions, vendor dialects supported and how unsupported dialects are handled.
Provide detailed emulation images, Docker hashes, and justify emulator fidelity relative to production.
Pre-register exact prompt templates, model identifiers, seeds, and retry policy; log model-call metadata.
Increase task diversity or stratify sample and justify 60-task size with power calculation; define inclusion/exclusion rules.
Define treatment of verifier false positives/negatives and analysis thresholds; include sensitivity analysis.

major_concerns: Verifier-to-LLM feedback parsing is brittle and may bias repair steps if underspecified.
Repair prompts can introduce regressions; need formalized repair prompt design and checks.
Iteration cap (5) may hide slower-but-correct convergences and bias conclusions.
Pipeline complexity makes full reproducibility challenging without exhaustive logging.
required_design_repairs: Define formal parser/spec for verifier feedback -> prompt templates that consume structured feedback.
Pre-register iteration cap rationale and run sensitivity analysis with alternative caps.
Log every iteration with hashes, prompt+response archives, and exact model identifiers; provide replay scripts.
Specify acceptance criteria for ‘pass’ and behavior on oscillating repairs; include termination diagnostics.

major_concerns: Adversarial/perturbation generation may be synthetic and not representative of real-world attacks without careful design.
Constrained-decoding implementation is underspecified (which algorithm/solver?), affecting reproducibility and effectiveness.
RAG index curation choices may strongly bias mitigation results; need exact provenance of indexed documents.
High model-call budget and dependence on auxiliary paraphrase/noise models can reduce reproducibility.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact perturbation generation methods, models, seeds, and provide perturbation corpus for reuse.
Define the constrained-decoding algorithm precisely (implementation, hyperparameters) and provide code.
Publish exact RAG index contents, retrieval settings, and dataset hashes; pre-register curation policy.
Pre-register mixed-effects model specification and covariates; include robustness checks for perturbation realism.

major_concerns: Compact benchmark may not cover operational diversity and risks overfitting to evaluated pipelines.
Creating reproducible emulation artifacts is brittle; portability across environments must be ensured.
Statistical discriminability with ~50 tasks may be underpowered unless effect sizes are large.
Benchmark publication plus five-page paper and required Disclosure may be tight on space.
required_design_repairs: Provide full artifact packaging (Docker images, hashes, automated deploy scripts) and licensing for reuse.
Justify benchmark size with power analysis; if underpowered, adjust task count or frame as pilot study.
Define baseline pipeline implementations and configuration exactly; include evaluation code and seeds.
Ensure Disclosure Statement and artifact-links fit within five pages; prepare concise artifact appendices and external repo with integrity hashes.
